translations.web: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
translations.bsb: So the commander dismissed the young man and instructed him, “Do not tell anyone that you have reported this to me.”
translations.kjv: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
translations.asv: So the chief captain let the young man go, charging him, Tell no man that thou hast signified these things to me.
